# CoArt Studio — Full Reference

> CoArt Studio is a human-first digital agency in Dubai. Real designers, strategists, and developers craft brand identities, social media content, video and photography, custom websites, mobile apps, AI automation, and digital marketing for businesses that want human expertise behind their technology. We use AI as a tool, not a replacement for creative thinking, strategic judgement, and the human connection that makes brands resonate.

## Company Overview

CoArt Studio is a digital agency built on one conviction: the best digital work comes from people who understand people. In a world where AI-generated content is everywhere, CoArt's differentiator is the human expertise behind every deliverable. Our designers, strategists, and developers bring taste, judgement, and genuine understanding of audiences to every project.

We serve startups, entrepreneurs, and established businesses across industries. Our approach combines human creative thinking with modern technology to help businesses build memorable brands, acquire customers, and grow sustainably. AI amplifies what our team can do; it never replaces the thinking that makes the work connect.

## Detailed Service Offerings

### 1. Content Production, Videography & Photography

We plan, shoot, and edit the content brands publish every week. Every shoot has human creative direction: understanding what the brand stands for, what stops the scroll for its audience, and how to turn one shoot day into weeks of usable content. AI can help with editing workflows, but the ideas, the direction on set, and the final cut come from people.

**Sub-services:**
- **Short-Form Social Video** — Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts, scripted and edited to hook viewers in the first seconds and built for how each platform works.
- **Brand & Corporate Video** — Brand films, launch videos, about-us videos, and event coverage that tell the business's story with craft.
- **Product & Lifestyle Photography** — Product, e-commerce, lifestyle, and team photography for websites, social media, and campaigns.
- **Shoot Planning & Creative Direction** — Concepts, shot lists, locations, talent, and on-set direction so every shoot produces content with a purpose.
- **Editing & Motion Graphics** — Post-production, colour grading, captions, and motion graphics, with English and Arabic versions where needed.
- **Monthly Content Production** — An ongoing supply of video and photo content for social media, planned alongside the brand's content calendar.

**Result:** For one Dubai hospitality and F&B client, CoArt's content reached nearly 215,000 Instagram views in 90 days, with 51% of views coming from non-followers, and the latest month drew 1.8x the monthly views of the two months before it.

### 2. Brand Identity Design

We create brand identities by hand, informed by strategy and built to connect with real people. Every identity is the product of human creative direction: understanding the business, feeling the audience, and making design decisions that no algorithm can replicate.

**Sub-services:**
- **Logo & Visual Identity** — A distinctive mark and visual system crafted by designers who understand that a great logo is about meaning, not just aesthetics.
- **Brand Strategy & Positioning** — The messaging and voice that sets you apart, developed through conversations with real people about real business goals.
- **Brand Guidelines** — A complete playbook so your brand is presented consistently: everywhere, by everyone.
- **Pitch Decks & Collateral** — Investor decks and sales materials that communicate your value with clarity and confidence.

**Result:** Brands refreshed by CoArt report 35% stronger audience recall within 60 days.

### 3. Web & Mobile App Development

We design and build human-centric digital products: websites, mobile apps, and SaaS platforms where every interaction feels intentional and every user journey is shaped by genuine understanding of how people behave, not just what analytics dashboards suggest.

**Sub-services:**
- **Custom Web Applications** — Scalable, high-performance web apps built around your business and your users, not a template.
- **Mobile App Development** — iOS and Android apps that feel native, load fast, and keep users coming back. From MVP to full product.
- **E-commerce & SaaS Platforms** — Revenue-generating digital products with conversion and retention designed by people who understand buyer psychology.
- **API & Backend Architecture** — The robust infrastructure your product needs to scale without breaking: clean APIs, secure databases.

**Result:** CoArt clients see an average 2.4x lift in online conversions after launch.

### 4. AI-Powered Automation

We integrate AI thoughtfully into business operations, always with human expertise guiding the strategy. The goal is never to replace people but to free them: AI handles the repetitive, time-intensive work so teams can focus on the creative, strategic, and relational work that humans do best.

**Sub-services:**
- **AI Search Optimization** — Get found on ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini, where the next generation of customers is already searching.
- **Business AI Integration** — Custom AI tools embedded into your operations, designed by people who understand both the technology and your business context.
- **AI Lead Generation** — Automated prospecting that identifies your highest-potential leads and fills your pipeline while your team focuses on closing.
- **Workflow Automation** — Turn your most time-consuming processes into intelligent automated systems, with human oversight built into the design.

**Result:** CoArt AI clients report up to 70% reduction in manual workload within the first 90 days.

### 5. Digital Marketing

We build marketing strategies rooted in understanding real audiences, not just algorithms. Every campaign is shaped by human insight into what makes communities engage, what makes customers trust, and what makes brands stick in memory.

**Sub-services:**
- **Social Media Management** — Consistent, on-brand content that connects with real communities on the platforms your audience actually uses. Our biggest service area.
- **SEO & Content Strategy** — Rank higher, get found faster. We build the SEO foundations that drive compounding organic growth through genuinely useful content.
- **Paid Advertising** — High-ROI campaigns across Google and Meta: built around data, tested relentlessly, optimised by people who understand the nuance behind the numbers.
- **Performance Analytics** — Clear dashboards that show exactly what's working, what isn't, and precisely where to invest next.

**Result:** CoArt marketing clients average a 3x increase in qualified leads within the first 90 days.

## Our Proven Process

1. **Discover & Strategize** — We dive deep into your business, brand, and goals through real conversations with real people. Every strategy we craft is tailored to you.
2. **Design & Create** — We turn strategy into creative work with human taste and judgement: brand identities, UI/UX designs, video, photography, and content that captures your vision.
3. **Build & Launch** — We bring your digital products to life with clean, scalable code and robust infrastructure, then launch with precision and care.
4. **Grow & Optimise** — Launch is just the beginning. We continuously monitor, test, and optimise to maximise your growth and ROI over time.

- Data-driven approach with measurable ROI

## Typical Dubai Pricing (from CoArt's published guides, 2026, excluding VAT)

- Social media management: AED 4,000-9,000/month for 1-2 platforms; AED 9,000-20,000/month for multi-platform growth packages; AED 30,000-60,000/month full service with content production. Source: https://www.coart.studio/blog/social-media-management-cost-dubai
- Social media content production: AED 1,500-6,000 per finished Reel; AED 7,000-20,000 per full shoot day; AED 8,000-35,000/month content retainer. Source: https://www.coart.studio/blog/social-media-content-production-cost-dubai
- Product photography: AED 150-600 per e-commerce image; AED 4,000-12,000 per half-day lifestyle shoot; AED 10,000-30,000 per full-day campaign shoot. Source: https://www.coart.studio/blog/product-photography-cost-dubai
- Branding: AED 5,000-500,000 depending on scope (logo, full identity, rebrand). Source: https://www.coart.studio/blog/branding-cost-dubai
- Websites: AED 1,500-185,000+ depending on type. Source: https://www.coart.studio/blog/website-cost-dubai
- Mobile apps: AED 18,000-1,470,000 depending on platform and complexity. Source: https://www.coart.studio/blog/mobile-app-development-cost-dubai
- AI consulting: AED 25,000-1,470,000 per project. Source: https://www.coart.studio/blog/ai-consulting-cost-dubai

Every CoArt project starts with a free discovery call and a tailored AED proposal.
